scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma generate && npm run seed
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install && npx prisma generate
scripts.start: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && node src/index.js
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
